name: Minoan frescoes
description: Ancient Aegean wall paintings: leaping dolphins and fish, lilies, crocuses and swallows, and stylised profile figures with long dark hair, painted flat on rough lime plaster with cracks, losses and faded edges.
light: no light source, flat colour on plaster
soft museum light raking across the plaster surface
warm sunlit plaster, colours a little bleached
composition: a frieze band across the wall, repeating creatures or figures
a few large figures in profile on a plain ground
a whole painted room seen from the doorway
a fragment: part of the scene missing, raw plaster around it
camera_or_medium: fresco on lime plaster, mineral pigments, flat colour with dark outlines, photographed straight on
texture_detail: chalky plaster texture, cracks and flaked areas, wavy borders and rosette bands, flat ochre, red, blue and black with a thin dark outline, uneven faded edges
subjects: a frieze of blue dolphins and small fish
a field of red lilies with swallows in flight
three robed figures walking in profile carrying vessels
a sea wall of octopus, seaweed and wavy bands
